_note: Backend visual-regression baseline. On a rig with box3d built, run `node physics/backend-qa-check.mjs --update` to record the box3d|Jolt envelope; then `node physics/backend-qa-check.mjs` gates every run against it. v3337: the capture now records the PERCEPTUAL floor too (silhouette IoU, scale delta, SSIM, edge overlap, pHash bits) in the same pass, and a pair with NO recorded envelope now FAILS as UNMEASURED instead of passing silently -- so the first rig run where box3d loads will go RED and name this command, rather than going green while measuring nothing. pairs is empty because box3d has never loaded wherever --update was last run.
